statement: Within SDL's fallback Bluetooth path, receiving the separate Guide report marks Guide as separately reported and suppresses the inline Guide bit in later state reports. Its battery decoder maps a two-bit level to approximate 10, 40, 70 or 100 percent and interprets mode flags to classify battery versus charging. These are consumer interpretations; neither establishes battery report frequency nor physical fuel-gauge calibration.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
